label: Write a daily briefing with a local LLM and send it to Slack
description: Every weekday morning, collects your unread Gmail inbox, open Google Tasks, Slack mentions and the next 24 hours of Google Calendar, and hands them to Qwen3 8B running in your own Ollama. The model picks out priorities, things you are waiting on and meetings that need preparation, drops the noise, and the briefing arrives as a Slack direct message with a link back to every source.

triggers.label: Every weekday at 07:30
triggers.description: Starts the workflow at 07:30 London time, Monday to Friday. Change the hour, days and timezone to match your morning.
triggers.name: trigger_1

tasks.label: End of the briefing window
tasks.description: Adds 24 hours to the trigger time. The calendar step uses this as the end of the window it looks at.
tasks.name: dateHelper_1

tasks.label: Get the next 24 hours of meetings
tasks.description: Reads events from your primary Google Calendar that fall between now and the same time tomorrow.
tasks.name: googleCalendar_1

tasks.label: Get open tasks
tasks.description: Lists the tasks in your default Google Tasks list that are not completed yet.
tasks.name: googleTasks_1

tasks.label: Find Slack messages that mention me
tasks.description: Searches Slack for the 30 newest messages that mention you. Replace @your-handle with your own Slack handle.
tasks.name: slack_1

tasks.label: Find unread inbox emails
tasks.description: Lists up to 25 unread emails in the Primary inbox category. Gmail returns only the message and thread IDs here, so the loop below reads each one.
tasks.name: googleMail_1

tasks.label: Read each email
tasks.description: Goes through the unread emails one by one and keeps a compact version of each for the model.
tasks.name: loop_1

iteratee.label: Get sender, subject and snippet
iteratee.description: Fetches only the From, Subject and Date headers plus Gmail's snippet, which keeps the prompt small enough for a local model.
iteratee.name: googleMail_2

iteratee.label: Add the email to the list
iteratee.description: Appends the headers, snippet and a Gmail link to the emails list stored for this run.
iteratee.name: dataStorage_1

tasks.label: Get the email list
tasks.description: Reads back every email the loop collected. Returns an empty list on a morning with no unread email.
tasks.name: dataStorage_2

tasks.label: Write the briefing
tasks.description: Qwen3 8B in your own Ollama reads the four lists and writes the briefing. Nothing is sent to a hosted AI API. The context window is raised to 16K tokens so a busy morning still fits.
tasks.name: ollama_1

parameters.systemPrompt:
You are a chief of staff who writes one short morning briefing. You do not chat and you do not invent anything.

You get four lists: unread inbox emails, open tasks, recent Slack messages that mention the user, and calendar events for the next 24 hours. Read all of them, then decide what actually needs the user's attention today.

Rules:
- Ignore newsletters, receipts, marketing, automated notifications and casual chatter.
- If several emails, messages or tasks are about the same thing, merge them into one item.
- Every item gets one line of context and the link to its source (the email link, the Slack permalink, the event htmlLink). Never make up a link. If an item has no link, leave the link out.
- Separate what the user has to do from what the user is waiting on other people for.
- For each meeting, say what to prepare: open questions from related emails or messages, documents to read, decisions still pending. If nothing relates to a meeting, write "No prep found".
- If a section is empty, write "Nothing today".
- Keep the whole briefing under 300 words.

Reply in Slack mrkdwn, exactly in this layout and with nothing before or after it:

*Good morning. Here is your briefing.*

*Priorities*
- <item> - <one line of context> <link>

*Waiting on others*
- <who> - <what> <link>

*Meetings to prepare for*
- <time> <title> - <what to prepare> <link>

*Skipped*
<number> items looked like noise and were left out.

tasks.label: Send the briefing to me on Slack
tasks.description: Sends the briefing to you as a Slack direct message. Replace U0123456789 with your own Slack member ID.
tasks.name: slack_2
